name: QuickBooks Online
description: QuickBooks Online is Intuit's cloud-based accounting and bookkeeping software for small businesses, covering invoicing, expense tracking, bank reconciliation, financial reporting, and optional payroll, with the largest bookkeeper and accountant ecosystem of any small-business accounting product.
best_for: Small businesses that want the accounting software most bookkeepers and CPAs already know how to use, and don't mind a higher list price for that ecosystem support.
features: Profit & loss, balance sheet, and cash-flow reporting
Multi-user access with role permissions (Plus and above)
Mobile app for invoicing and mileage tracking

tiers.name: Simple Start
tiers.notes: Single user; invoicing, expense tracking, basic reporting.

tiers.name: Essentials
tiers.notes: Up to 3 users; adds bill management and time tracking.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Up to 5 users; adds inventory tracking and project profitability.

tiers.name: Advanced
tiers.notes: Up to 25 users; adds custom reporting, batch invoicing, and dedicated support.

pros: Widest accountant/bookkeeper familiarity of any small-business accounting tool, which matters when hiring or working with outside help
Deep, mature feature set covering invoicing through payroll in one product family
Strong bank and payment-processor integration coverage
cons: List prices are meaningfully higher than direct competitors like Xero at the same tier
Frequent promotional discounting on the pricing page makes the real ongoing cost easy to underestimate at signup
Add-on pricing (payroll, payments) is billed separately from the core subscription

faq.question: Is QuickBooks Online the same as QuickBooks Desktop?
faq.answer: No — QuickBooks Online is a separate, browser-based product with its own pricing and feature set. QuickBooks Desktop is a locally installed application Intuit sells and supports on a different track.

faq.question: Do I need a bookkeeper to use QuickBooks Online?
faq.answer: No, but its large ecosystem of bookkeepers and accountants who already know the product is one of its main practical advantages if you plan to hire outside help later.

alternatives.name: Xero
alternatives.description: Cloud accounting software built around real-time collaboration between a business and its accountant or bookkeeper.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses that want lower list pricing and work closely with an accountant who already uses Xero

alternatives.name: FreshBooks
alternatives.description: Cloud accounting and invoicing software built for service-based small businesses and freelancers with built-in time tracking.
alternatives.best_for: Service businesses and freelancers prioritizing simple invoicing and project time tracking

alternatives.name: Wave
alternatives.description: Free cloud accounting and invoicing software designed for solopreneurs and freelancers.
alternatives.best_for: Solopreneurs and micro-businesses seeking zero-subscription invoicing and bookkeeping

alternatives.name: Zoho Books
alternatives.description: Cloud accounting software that automates core financial workflows, handles multi-currency invoicing, manages inventory, and integrates with the wider Zoho ecosystem.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized businesses and existing Zoho users wanting workflow automation and cost-effective multi-user accounting
